blocks.text: Savouge completed a remarkable turnaround, dispatching sister team ClearSkiiin in four sets, 23-25, 25-16, 25-20, 25-17, to close out the elimination round of the 2026 Spikers’ Turf Invitational Conference on Saturday at the Philsports Arena.
